'''Briggs''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] soldier who served in the [[Cularin Militia]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], he was sent to the [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] jungle with a Militia detachment, so the site of a decoy conference, which had been organized to stop the [[Believers]] attacking a conference on [[Tilnes]]. Briggs was unaware of this and believed that the conference on Cularin was the real one.

He was a very committed soldier and liked to do his job to the best of his ability. He also had a very deep voice.
